title: Sealed Bids at Midnight
summary: Rust Ootle auction template and headless CLI with signer-bound, domain-separated commit/reveal bids and equal bonds. Epochs define sealing, reveal and settlement, followed by separate lot, proceeds and refund claims. Unrevealed bids and bids below reserve permanently forfeit bonds, which stay locked in the component. Revealed amounts and bidder keys are public; multiple commitments let bidders choose what to reveal. MIT source pins tari_template_lib 0.34. The maintainer reports 17 tests and an Esmeralda v2 lifecycle; no bids, bridging or payouts were executed for this listing. The README timeline says forfeited bonds go to the seller, conflicting with its detailed v2 description and announcement. November 4 review: README unchanged at f8796ec7, no releases, and the original Reddit post shows no comments. The documented Esmeralda component returns Substate not found; no replacement address was found in the reviewed README or announcement. The November 2 organizer notice asked entrants to republish after the testnet reset. The retained October 20 README walkthrough includes the creator’s historical terminal GIF; it does not show a new auction execution. Earlier evidence remains in the maintenance history.
cardSummary: Run sealed-bid auctions with equal entry bonds, timed reveals and separate claims for winners, sellers and losing bidders.
cardStatus: Source code · Testnet · Forfeited bonds locked forever
